svg.text: RF input bias (LNA drives the mixer: 5 kohm to VBRF) + bias divider
LO AC coupling (2 pF) + 20 kohm to the switch-gate biases (upper 1.8 V, lower 1.2 V)
LO load trim (NMOS gate caps on the switch-gate nodes, sized from the PEX loads)
I mixer: Gm pair, lower switch pairs, upper switch quads, RC load
Q mixer: Gm pair, lower switch pairs, upper switch quads, RC load
